mechanism: CAACP-HQKV — hyperbolic (Lorentz) dual-branch SAT-style QKV change aggregation over all four VMamba-Tiny stage outputs, plus HGSL (hyperbolic geometric supervision loss)

backbone_change.to: VMamba-Tiny v2 (NeurIPS 2024) depths=[2,2,9,2] dims=[96,192,384,768] ssm_ratio=2.0 patch4 ln2d
backbone_change.kernel: selective_scan_cuda_oflex (same kernel as Run1-Run7; casacd's own selective_scan_cuda.so is ABI-broken - see models/model/layers/vmamba_kernel.py)
why_not_run7_comparable: TinyViM has frequency decoupling (Laplace mixer + dense local_conv HF branch); VMamba has none
pre-norm placement and normalisation layers differ (Conv2d_BN vs LayerNorm2d pre-norm)

user_rulings_2026_10_15.P0-1_budget: DEPLOY <=5M constraint LIFTED. New constraint: the model's total learnable parameters, EXCLUDING VMamba-Tiny itself, should be as small as possible (no hard numeric ceiling).
user_rulings_2026_10_15.P0-2_staging: ACCEPTED: staged, one variable per stage, each stage with a same-wave CTRL
user_rulings_2026_10_15.R6_decomposition: manifold radius: local dispersion (detail) vs global radius (global)
user_rulings_2026_10_15.R8_k: token count N -> k*N for K/V; Q stays N*C
user_rulings_2026_10_15.R9_loss: new loss APPROVED by the user for this round only; any FURTHER loss needs explicit review; keep the number of losses minimal
user_rulings_2026_10_15.R9_injection: injection is MANDATORY to keep, but where/how to inject is an experimental variable
user_rulings_2026_10_15.R4_injection_point: implement as a switch and ablate

mechanism_definition.hyperbolic_model: Lorentz (hyperboloid), kappa=1, no explicit C+1 tensor
mechanism_definition.radius_rule: r_{t,i} = r0 + a * q_{t,i}, with r0=0.5, a=0.5 FIXED (r in [0.5, 1.0]); searching them is forbidden
mechanism_definition.detail_radius: q = clip((1 - cos(u_i, mean_{3x3}(u_i)))/2, 0, 1)  -- local dispersion of the same timestep
mechanism_definition.global_radius: q = clip(||x_i - mean_HW(x_t)|| / (||x_i|| + eps), 0, 1)  -- deviation from the same timestep's global mean
mechanism_definition.distance: cosh d = cosh(rA)cosh(rB) - sinh(rA)sinh(rB)<uA,uB>; d = acosh(max(1, cosh d)); s = 1 - exp(-d)
mechanism_definition.non_degeneracy: the fixed-radius case reduces to a strictly monotone function of 1-cos (rank-identical, provable); variable radius is what breaks it. Verified numerically in models/_legacy/test_run8_cpu_precheck.py C2/C3.
mechanism_definition.k_v_compression: detail branch: change-score weighted pooling inside a fixed 2x2 grid (k=1/4); global branch: deviation-weighted pooling on a fixed 4x4 grid (k=1/16). Both are REGULAR GRIDS - no TopK, no clustering, no random sampling.
mechanism_definition.q_full: Q keeps the native token count N at every stage; Q/K/V are split-check: V uses a per-channel depthwise 1x1 (groups=rank) so the branch parameter cost is dim*rank*3 instead of 2*dim^2
mechanism_definition.no_rank: CRITICAL: rank_normalize_2d is NOT used. rank() discards all magnitude information, so ANY order-preserving transform (including hyperbolic distance) yields bit-identical weights after it. Run8 consumes raw numeric scores through softmax instead.
mechanism_definition.branch_specialisation: each branch has its own q/k/v/proj; two zero-initialised gates gamma_detail / gamma_global
mechanism_definition.injection: per-stage outputs are upsampled to 1/4, summed, gated by gamma_detail, then added to the DCR 1/4 input (feats[0]); inject_mode dcr1_16 additionally adds it to the 1/16 skip

hgsl_loss.name: HGSL - Hyperbolic Geometric Supervision Loss
hgsl_loss.definition: L = (1/4) * sum_{i in 0..3} [ BCE(s_i, y_i) + (1 - Dice(s_i, y_i)) ], total = BCE+Dice + lambda * L
hgsl_loss.s_i: the module's own Lorentz change score at stage i (B,1,H_i,W_i)
hgsl_loss.y_i: adaptive_max_pool2d(gt, H_i)  -- MAX, not AVG, so 1-15px objects are not averaged away
hgsl_loss.lambda: 0.2 FIXED (same value as Run7 HFAE; searching is forbidden)
hgsl_loss.difference_from_run7_hfae: HFAE supervises a NEW parameterised head on TinyViM's local_conv HF taps with a GT contour band; HGSL supervises a PARAMETER-FREE geometric quantity with the change mask, and CAACP's score had never received gradient before (Run1-Run7 always ran it under no_grad)
hgsl_loss.gradient_paths: hgsl_detach_score=1 -> gradient does not enter the geometry (only reshapes how the score is consumed); =0 -> the Lorentz geometry itself is optimised. These are DIFFERENT arms and must not be reported as one thing.

variants.name: H2_EUC
variants.role: MANDATORY counterfactual: identical radial quantities, tangential distance. Answers 'is the curvature necessary?'

budget.budget_rule: user ruling P0-1: no hard ceiling; report backbone params and NON-backbone params separately; keep non-backbone small
budget.gpu_layout: GPU0 only, four datasets SERIAL (GPU1 is occupied by another project of the same user: ~24.5GB / 100%)

acceptance_criteria.primary: four-dataset test F1 vs same-wave CTRL_R8
acceptance_criteria.accept: H1_HYP has F1 >= CTRL_R8 on >=3/4 datasets AND SYSU F1 strictly greater, with all mechanism self-checks passing
acceptance_criteria.curvature_requirement: H1_HYP must beat H2_EUC with the SAME sign on >=3/4 datasets before ANY claim that negative curvature is necessary
acceptance_criteria.if_H1_ge_CTRL_but_H1_approx_H2: conclusion becomes 'local radial structural evidence helps'; the hyperbolic/curvature story must be dropped
acceptance_criteria.if_H1_le_CTRL: record MECHANISM-FAIL with attribution; no parameter retuning
acceptance_criteria.negative_results_are_mandatory: same as Run6/Run7 practice - a negative result is written up, not hidden

acceptance_criteria_frozen_numeric._why: freeze the prose acceptance rule into machine-checkable numbers BEFORE any Run8 training, so the rule cannot be reinterpreted after seeing results.
acceptance_criteria_frozen_numeric._guardrail_note: reuses Run6/Run7's already-frozen 'medium/large pooled Recall >= CTRL - 0.02' and 'CDD/WHU F1 drop <= 0.002'; no new thresholds invented
acceptance_criteria_frozen_numeric._non_degeneracy_note: the detail-vs-global branch rank disagreement on real features must exceed 0.05; otherwise the 'two-branch decomposition' is not actually decomposing anything and the mechanism gate fails

mechanism_selfchecks: [PRETRAIN-LOAD] worst_diff == 0 and retained > 0 (VMamba official 222 keys load bitwise)
gamma_detail / gamma_global receive non-zero gradient at step 1 (otherwise the injection path is not connected)
[HGSL-LOSS] finite and decreasing across epochs (H3 only)
[ACTUAL-OPT-STEPS] 80000 inside the LAST complete TEST block

known_risks.R1_diag1_says_caacp_internal_is_weak: Diag1 measured ||beta*deltaC||/||c_avg|| = 0.19% on M1 and beta-OFF dF1 = -2.2e-6. Run8 does NOT reuse rank and does NOT gate through a single scalar beta; the branch output is added directly with a per-branch gamma. But E9's beta was 4x larger than M1's on SYSU (0.0224 vs 0.0056), so the M1 number must NOT be extrapolated.
known_risks.R2_curvature_may_be_rank_equivalent_to_e: CPU precheck measured Kendall tau(H, E) = 0.9983 on random features. If this holds on real features, H1 ~= H2 and the curvature claim dies. H2_EUC exists precisely to catch this.
known_risks.R3_injection_precedent_failed: Run7 E10 (aux_inject) did not beat E9 (aux_only) and cost SYSU small-object recall -0.0351. Run8's injection differs in position (DCR 1/4 input from a change-aware aggregation, not an edge head) but this is NOT evidence that it will work.
known_risks.R4_casaa_precedent: CASAA (full-Q + compressed K/V) was terminated with 'deployable routing ranking improvement != F1 improvement'. Run8 differs in grid regularity, geometry, branch count, injection point and score source, but the risk is not disproven.
known_risks.R5_backbone_param_count_discrepancy: the project handoff document says 'official VMamba-T ~30M', but a v2-config build measures 42,954,720. The exact count of vssm_tiny_0230_ckpt_epoch_262.pth must be reconciled against the weight file before it goes into the paper.
known_risks.R6_gpu_contention: GPU1 is occupied by another project (~24.5GB/100%). Four datasets run SERIAL on GPU0; Run7 wave 3 OOMed on GPU0 when two heavy runs shared the card.
